title: The Promise by the Fire
question: Today, can Jekyll keep his secret of Hyde and still win Utterson's promise to protect him?
light: firelight from the hearth at, deep black shadows
palette: deep black panelling, crimson leather, orange firelight, bone-white linen, brass glints
look: gothic anime, heavy black shadow masses, sharp ink lines, firelit faces
motif: the blistered door and the bright key that opens it

fire_wide.described: The doctor's dining hall at night. A long dark oak table runs across the BACK under a brass gas lamp, its white cloth holding emptied wine glasses and a silver decanter. A tall carved stone fireplace stands on the LEFT wall, its high mantel shelf holding a black marble clock and a bright brass key lying beside it. Two deep crimson leather armchairs face each other across a dark red hearth rug. Black panelled walls carry framed anatomical engravings in gilt frames. A tall double door at the RIGHT stands open onto the lamplit hall. Orange firelight falls from the hearth at the LEFT across the rug and the chairs, throwing long black shadows toward the RIGHT wall. The brass gas lamp above the table throws a dim yellow glow down from the TOP.

shots.end: The doctor stands at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height, his hand held out toward the RIGHT; the lawyer's shoulder fills the RIGHT foreground, his hand raised; the mantel key at the TOP LEFT.
source: the moment I choose, I can be rid of Mr. Hyde. I give you my hand upon that
shots.turn: Utterson's rescue offered -> Jekyll turns it into his own pledge
shots.why: The lead's choice: Jekyll refuses help, swears he controls Hyde, and binds his friend with a hand.

shots.frame: Medium close of the lawyer (clean-shaven, long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face) in the near armchair, weighing the pledge as he looks into the fire.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in toward the lawyer's face across the whole shot; the lawyer looks down into the fire; his hand drums along the chair arm
shots.camera: Low beside the brass fender, six feet from the chair, a 50mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT and below.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the lawyer's face at the CENTRE, his head a third of the frame's height, his gaze down toward the hearth, lit orange from below. The brass fender glows along the BOTTOM edge. The oak table runs across the TOP third behind him, the double door half shut at the RIGHT.
shots.end: The lawyer's face fills the CENTRE, his head more than a third of the frame's height, his eyes on the hearth, his hand on the chair arm; the oak table across the TOP third; the door at the RIGHT.

sounds.sound: a coal fire crackling, a log settling in the grate

source: Utterson reflected a little, looking in the fire.
shots.turn: a pledge given -> a pledge weighed
shots.why: Silent reaction after the exchange: Utterson's doubt held in his face, pushed on the realisation.

shots.frame: Medium of the lawyer (clean-shaven, long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, long black double-breasted overcoat) getting to his feet from the pushed-back armchair at the RIGHT, the doctor (thick iron-grey hair, long black frock coat) standing before the mantel at the LEFT.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back from the between at a walking pace, across the whole shot; the lawyer gets to his feet from the armchair; his hands smooth down his overcoat front
shots.camera: At seated eye height on the hearth rug, eight feet from the armchair, a 40mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the seat of the pushed-back crimson armchair at the RIGHT third, the lawyer seated in it, his face a quarter of the frame's height. The doctor stands before the mantel shelf at the LEFT third, the black marble clock above his shoulder. The hearth rug runs across the BOTTOM third between the two.
shots.end: The lawyer stands at the RIGHT third before the armchair, his head a quarter of the frame's height, his hands at his overcoat front; the doctor stands at the LEFT third before the mantel; the hearth rug across the BOTTOM third.
source: he said at last, getting to his feet.
shots.turn: a seated guest -> a guest rising to leave
shots.why: Utterson yields and makes to go; Jekyll sees his chance closing.

shots.frame: Close of the doctor (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face, thick iron-grey hair) beside the mantel, one hand on the shelf near the bright key, as he raises the matter again.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame on the doctor across the whole shot; his hand rests on the mantel beside the brass key; his gaze lifts to his friend; his hand slides along the mantel shelf beside the key
shots.camera: At standing eye height before the hearth, four feet from the doctor, a 75mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT and below.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the doctor's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, lit orange from below at the LEFT. His large white hand rests on the mantel shelf at the LEFT edge beside the bright brass key. The black panelling rises at the TOP edge behind him.
shots.end: The doctor's face sits at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, his brow knit; his hand on the mantel shelf at the LEFT edge beside the key; the panelling at the TOP edge.
source: I have really a very great interest in poor Hyde.
shots.turn: the matter dropped -> the matter reopened by Jekyll
shots.why: Jekyll, who begged silence, now pleads for Hyde himself; his hand beside the key ties him to the motif.

shots.frame: Every surface in the picture is plain, wordless paint. Close of the doctor (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face) asking the promise, his face earnest in the firelight.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame on the doctor across the whole shot; he leans toward his friend; he asks the promise with his hand pressed to his chest; his breath lifts his chest
shots.camera: At standing eye height before the hearth, four feet from the doctor, a 75mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT and below.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the doctor's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, lit orange from below at the LEFT, his iron-grey hair brushed back. The black marble clock stands on the mantel at the LEFT edge. The gilt engraving frame glints at the TOP RIGHT.
shots.end: The doctor's face sits at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, leaning toward the RIGHT, his hand at his chest; the clock at the LEFT edge; the engraving at the TOP RIGHT.
source: I wish you to promise me that you will bear with him and get his rights for him
shots.turn: a confidence -> a demand for a promise
shots.why: The stake laid bare: Jekyll wants Hyde protected after his own end.

shots.frame: Close of the lawyer (clean-shaven, long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face) standing by the pushed-back armchair, refusing to pretend.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame on the lawyer across the whole shot; he turns his head aside; he speaks with his mouth set hard; his hand tightens on the armchair back
shots.camera: At standing eye height near the mantel, four feet from the lawyer, a 75mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the lawyer's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, lit orange from the LEFT, his lank grey hair at his collar. The crimson armchair back rises at the RIGHT edge behind him, his hand on it. Tall black shadows climb at a walking pace the panelling at the TOP.
shots.end: The lawyer's face sits at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, turned toward the RIGHT; his hand on the armchair back at the RIGHT edge; shadows on the panelling at the TOP.
source: I can’t pretend that I shall ever like him
shots.turn: a request -> an honest refusal of liking
shots.why: Utterson's distaste for Hyde stands; he will give justice at most.

shots.frame: Medium of the doctor (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face, long black frock coat) walking at a walking pace side-on from the mantel toward the pushed-back armchair at the RIGHT.
shots.motion: The camera tracks beside the doctor as he walks at a walking pace from the mantel toward the armchair at the RIGHT edge, across the whole shot; his large white hand lifts from his side; his head turns toward the RIGHT
shots.camera: At standing eye height beside the hearth rug, eight feet from the doctor, a 40mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the doctor standing side-on at the LEFT third before the mantel shelf, his head a quarter of the frame's height, his face turned toward the RIGHT. The black marble clock stands on the mantel above his shoulder. The crimson back of the pushed-back armchair rises at the RIGHT edge, the hearth rug across the BOTTOM third.
shots.end: The doctor stands at the RIGHT third beside the crimson armchair back, his hand lifted; the mantel and clock at the LEFT; the hearth rug across the BOTTOM third.
source: pleaded Jekyll
shots.turn: refused liking -> a man closing the distance to plead
shots.why: Silent reaction after the exchange: the refusal lands and Jekyll moves to plead in person.

shots.frame: Medium close past the near shoulder and the back of the head of the lawyer (lank grey hair) toward the doctor (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face) as he lays his hand upon the lawyer's arm.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame over the lawyer's shoulder toward the doctor across the whole shot; the doctor lays his large white hand upon the lawyer's arm as he pleads; at 00:04 his hand presses along the black sleeve and his head bows toward his friend
shots.camera: Behind the lawyer at standing shoulder height, five feet from the doctor, a 50mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the doctor's face at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height, before the mantel, lit orange from the LEFT. The lawyer's shoulder in his black overcoat and the back of his grey head fill the RIGHT foreground. The mantel clock stands at the TOP LEFT.
shots.end: The doctor stands at the LEFT third, his head a third of the frame's height, bowed toward the RIGHT, his hand on the lawyer's sleeve; the lawyer's shoulder fills the RIGHT foreground; the clock at the TOP LEFT.
source: I only ask for justice; I only ask you to help him for my sake, when I am no longer here.
shots.turn: a request -> a dying man's plea
shots.why: Jekyll speaks of being 'no longer here': the shadow of his end falls on the promise.

shots.frame: Medium two-shot at the hearth: the doctor (full, broad, smooth, clean-shaven face, long black frock coat) stands at the LEFT, his large white hand on the lawyer's sleeve. The lawyer (clean-shaven, long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face, long black double-breasted overcoat) stands nearer at the RIGHT, heaving a sigh.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame on the two men across the whole shot; the lawyer's chest heaves with a deep sigh; his shoulders rise and fall under the doctor's hand
shots.camera: At standing eye height on the hearth rug, ten feet from the two men, a 40mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the doctor's large white hand resting on the lawyer's black overcoat sleeve at the CENTRE. The doctor stands at the LEFT third before the mantel shelf, his head a quarter of the frame's height. The lawyer stands at the RIGHT third, nearer the camera and larger, his head a third of the frame's height, beside the crimson armchair back. Orange firelight falls across both men from the LEFT.
shots.end: The doctor stands at the LEFT third, his hand on the lawyer's sleeve at the CENTRE; the lawyer stands at the RIGHT third, his shoulders sunk, his eyes lowered; the mantel clock at the TOP LEFT; the armchair back at the RIGHT edge.
source: Utterson heaved an irrepressible sigh.
shots.turn: resistance -> yielding
shots.why: A held silent beat before the answer: the sigh is Utterson giving in, held as a locked two-shot.

shots.frame: Close of the lawyer (clean-shaven, long, gaunt, rugged, unsmiling face) lowering his eyes as he gives his word.
shots.motion: The camera holds a locked-off frame on the lawyer across the whole shot; he lowers his eyes; he gives one nod as he speaks; his shoulders sink under the overcoat
shots.camera: At standing eye height near the mantel, four feet from the lawyer, a 75mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the lawyer's face at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, lit orange from the LEFT. His lank grey hair, white at the sides, falls to his collar. The crimson armchair back rises at the RIGHT edge, tall shadows on the panelling at the TOP.
shots.end: The lawyer's face sits at the CENTRE, his head half the frame's height, his eyes lowered, his shoulders sunk; the armchair back at the RIGHT edge; shadows on the panelling at the TOP.
source: I promise.
shots.turn: a refusal -> a promise given
shots.why: The world's answer: Jekyll keeps his secret and wins the promise to protect Hyde.

shots.frame: Wide of the dining hall from eye level, the two men standing small on the hearth rug before the fireplace, the lawyer (long black double-breasted overcoat) and the doctor (long black frock coat), the gas lamp and the oak table above them.
shots.motion: The camera rises above the two men on the hearth rug, looking down over the fireplace and the mantel key across the whole shot; the lawyer turns toward the open double door; the fire flames lick up the chimney throat
shots.camera: At standing eye height near the end of the oak table, twenty feet from the hearth, a 28mm lens; the firelight comes from the LEFT.
shots.at_rest: THE FOCUS OF THE PICTURE IS the stone fireplace at the LEFT third, its mantel shelf with the bright brass key. The brass gas lamp and the oak table hold the TOP third. The lawyer and the doctor stand on the hearth rug in the lower half, each a fifth of the frame's height, the open double door at the RIGHT edge.
shots.end: A high view of the dining hall: the fireplace and mantel key at the LEFT, the hearth rug at the CENTRE with the two men small at the BOTTOM, the lawyer facing the double door at the RIGHT edge.

sounds.sound: a mantel clock chiming the hour
a coal fire crackling in the grate

source: I promise.
shots.turn: a promise spoken -> a promise binding two small men
shots.why: The bird's-eye after the answer: the bargain sealed under the mantel key, the motif.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The guests left. Utterson stayed behind to corner his host.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hosts loved to keep the dry lawyer back, sobering their minds in his rich, unspoken company.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jekyll was no exception: fifty, handsome, a little sly, and warmly fond of his old friend.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: You know that will of yours?

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: You are unfortunate in such a client.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Gaily he turned the talk to Lanyon instead, that hide-bound pedant who sneered at all his scientific heresies.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Utterson brushed the fresh topic aside without mercy; he had never once approved of that will.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The charm thinned at the edges; the will was a sorer subject than all his laughter owned.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: I have been learning something of young Hyde.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At that name, the doctor's large handsome face grew pale to the very lips.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Blackness gathered about his staring eyes.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: I do not care to hear more.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: What I heard was abominable.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: You do not understand my position.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Make a clean breast of this.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: The moment I choose, I can be rid of Hyde.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Rid of him, the moment he chooses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At last the lawyer got to his feet, content for now to let the private matter sleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then, for the last time he hoped, the doctor raised it himself: he cared greatly for poor Hyde.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: Promise you will get his rights for him.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: I can't pretend I shall ever like him.

lines.speaker: henry_jekyll
lines.text: I don't ask that. Help him for my sake.

lines.speaker: gabriel_john_utterson
lines.text: Well, I promise.
